attributes.description: Lifetime playtime per account, split by the platform it was played on. The Steam Web API only reports platforms for the account that owns the API key, so other accounts are not listed. Steam began tracking platforms later than total playtime, so the platforms do not add up to the lifetime total. Lifetime playtime only ever grows, so the highest value seen in the time range is the most recent one.
